description: This Java class implements a SubjectNode that is a type of PolicyTreeNode, representing a subject in a policy enforcement tree. It manages subject node details such as its name, children, and supports visitor pattern for traversal.

classes.name: SubjectNode
classes.description: Implementation of {@link PolicyTreeNode} for subject nodes, representing a node in a policy tree with a name and children.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectNode with the given name, checking for null input.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subject node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the node, which is SUBJECT.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by resource name, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child PolicyTreeNode to this node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing this node and its children.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the map of child nodes.
